rules.statement: An amendment of the plaint by adding a claim which had been omitted is permissible under Section 34(2) of the Civil Procedure Code, provided that such amendment does not alter the fundamental character of the action or introduce a different cause of action.
rules.supporting_quote: "Hence it is open to plaintiff to amend his plaint by the addition of any claim which he is entitled to make in respect of the cause of action pleaded in the plaint."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 34 (1) and (2) of the Civil Procedure Code mandates that 'every action shall include the whole of the claim which the plaintiff is entitled to make in respect of the cause of action' and if the plaintiff omits to sue in respect of or intentionally relinquishes any portion of his claim, he shall not afterwards sue in respect of the portion so omitted.

meta.parties: Mackinnon Mackenzie & Co. v. Grindlays Bank Ltd
